title: task.create — Request
description: Create a task in a project. Idempotent via operation_id. The server determines created_by from the authenticated actor; clients MUST NOT supply it. Clients may provide project_id directly or repo_path for project auto-resolution.

operation_id.description: UUIDv7 (time-ordered). Same operation_id replays the cached response. Same operation_id with a different request body returns 409 Conflict.

repo_path.description: Canonical local repo root path. Implementations resolve this to a project and return the concrete task.project_id.

assignee_id.description: Optional initial assignee. NULL or omitted means unassigned.
